disclaimer: Model estimates. No sportsbook prices were available, so every price is blank. Entertainment, not advice.
method: Legs sit on the pipeline projection, on the side of a half-point line the projection favors. Hit chances are the player's own prior games on that side, shrunk toward one half. Prices are blank.
